scope.boundary_rule: Recovered from stale catch-up artifacts; original source windows/clocks remain in migration_provenance.

migration_provenance.normalization_note: Normalized start forward by 152 seconds to eliminate stale overlap with the prior recovered sweep; original stale window remains preserved.

new_events.summary: Saudi Civil Defence issued hostile-aerial-threat warnings for Riyadh and Al-Kharj; residents/reporters heard booms and observed flames/black smoke near King Khalid International Airport before an all-clear. At this horizon cause, weapon, precise impact point, BDA and casualties were unresolved.

Iran announced the execution of Hossein Pedaran after a judiciary conviction for spying for Mossad and supplying information on missile sites. The execution is a state-announced event; espionage conduct and motive remain state allegations/conviction findings rather than independently established intelligence facts.

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters reported the Washington Post, citing five unidentified officials, counted at least 22 U.S. military fatalities during the Iran-war period, versus a Pentagon public figure of 18. Some additional deaths may not be directly combat-related; Defense Secretary Hegseth called the report false. Preserve both series until identities/circumstances and combat attribution are reconciled.

UNIFIL leadership reported planning transfer of responsibilities before the mission's scheduled end-of-2026 withdrawal while coordinating with the Lebanese army and UN agencies. Israeli positions and stalled Hezbollah-disarmament efforts remained; no replacement mission was established.

CENTCOM said successful oil shipments had moved through Hormuz. No newer in-window commercial daily transit dataset displaced the Kpler Thursday count; the statement supports continued passage, not normalized or unrestricted traffic.
Reuters reported Israeli strikes killed at least three Palestinians on Sep.19. Israel said targets included militants; casualty identities and militant status remained contested.

unresolved_questions: Cause and weapon associated with observed Riyadh airport-area fire
Reconciliation of U.S. 18 official versus at-least-22 period fatalities
Replacement security mechanism after UNIFIL withdrawal
Latest independent Hormuz commercial transit count

material_results: Riyadh threat, U.S. fatality denominator, Iran execution, UNIFIL and Hormuz passage status recovered.
checked_no_material_new_event_in_window: No new Qeshm MQ-9, F-15SA, pipeline or China-pressure disposition change located in stale source artifact.
limitations: Riyadh fire attribution was unresolved at this horizon.
Competing U.S. fatality totals use unresolved denominator/combat-status definitions.
